name: AquaticCLIP Dataset
description: A large-scale underwater image-text paired dataset with 2 million pairs constructed from heterogeneous resources for aquatic scene understanding tasks such as segmentation, classification, detection, and object counting.
reputation: A newly introduced large-scale aquatic multimodal dataset that is promising for underwater vision research but is not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Dataset is large-scale (2 million pairs) and constructed from diverse sources; enables zero-shot evaluation in underwater vision-language tasks.
